name: Pension
overview: Scripture reveals that the provision for the Levites and priests was carefully organized according to their genealogies and assigned duties, beginning from specific ages as part of their service to the house of the LORD. Their daily portions and responsibilities were distributed in a manner that honored their sacred office and the holiness required in their roles. This arrangement extended not only to the men but also encompassed their families, reflecting the comprehensive care and trust placed upon those who sanctified themselves in their appointed ministry.
